title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-04
content:
Meeting goals:
- Align on Q1 OKR progress and identify top 3 risks
- Decide canary plan for Dedicated GA and rollback triggers
- Review incident trends and SRE capacity needs
- Agree on action items and owners

Agenda:
1) Quick status: wins & top risks (5 min)
2) Product: Dedicated GA readiness (10 min)
   - rollout schedule, canary %s, metrics to watch (p95 latency, per-token cost, error rate)
   - gating items: autoscale policy docs, capacity buffer config, support runbook
3) Private deployments & compliance (8 min)
   - progress on FedRAMP / SOC2 edge cases, legal review for on-prem contract
4) SRE / incidents (8 min)
   - recent cache invalidation incident (Feb 27) root cause, mitigations
   - capacity forecast for May spike
5) GTM / sales signals (5 min)
   - enterprise pilots: 3 customers requesting dedicated/private trials
6) People / hiring asks (4 min)
7) Review action items & next steps (5 min)

Prep notes / talking points:
- OKRs: Product adoption metric is +12% M/M; we are behind target by 8% on new Dedicated signups - propose promotional credit + engineering concierge for first 3 customers.
- Dedicated GA: Need final sign-off on autoscaling SLOs from SRE (Ben). If we don't get sign-off by Mar 10, push GA by 2 weeks.
- Private: Legal flagged data residency clause in template; Claire to propose alternate wording by Mar 6.
- Incident: Root cause was stale KV cache invalidation script; mitigation deployed Feb 28. Need postmortem draft by Mar 9 and long-term fix (automated cache consistency check).
- Capacity: Forecast shows 2.5x token growth by May; propose adding 8 dedicated GPUs to reserved pool - Marco to confirm budget.

Action items:
- Ben Rodriguez: Finalize SRE sign-off checklist for Dedicated autoscale SLOs. Due: 2026-03-10. Linked: JIRA-ENG-4712
- Claire Nguyen: Draft updated on-prem contract clause for data residency; share with Legal. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Marco Silva: Confirm budget and procurement timeline for +8 GPUs for May capacity; coordinate with infra. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Aisha Kumar: Prepare short customer-facing GA note and proposed promo credit details. Due: 2026-03-08.
- Ops (SRE): Draft postmortem for Feb 27 cache incident, include remediation plan. Due: 2026-03-09.
- Product Marketing (assigned: Jenna Park): Create one-pager for Enterprise pilots (Dedicated & Private) to share with SDRs. Due: 2026-03-11.

Risks & decisions needed:
- Decision: Approve promo credit + concierge for first 3 Dedicated customers (Y/N) - need leadership OK by Mar 6.
- Risk: If SRE doesn't sign-off, GA delay impacts sales commitments. Contingency: staged GA with limited regions.

Notes to self:
- Bring updated cost delta table (per-token cost by quantization level) - ask Optimize team for latest numbers.
- Remind Legal to re-run template against customer NDA from Acme Corp.
- Follow-up 1:1 with Ben after meeting to unblock checklist items.

Meeting logistics:
- When: 2026-03-04 09:00 PT
- Duration: 45 min
- Where: VC: exec-staff-zoom
- Attendees: exec staff + SRE lead + product marketing

Follow-ups (tracking):
- I'll add items to the exec board and ping owners in Slack (#exec-action-items).
